name: Ayame
source:
A mysterious girl that looks up at the sky every night in the schoolyard during summer vacation.

She doesn't seem to be a student at Sakura Junior High School, so why does she come to the empty schoolyard all by herself?

[Translated from [url=https://www.spike-chunsoft.co.jp/games/3b/chara11.html]official website[/url]]
